# Pokédex

> Free online Pokédex built with Vue 3, Pinia and Vite, using data from the PokéAPI. Browse all 1025 Pokémon (Generation 1 to 9) in a Game Boy-style device UI.

Live app: https://raphaelwilker.github.io/pokedex/
Source code: https://github.com/raphaelwilker/pokedex
Author: Raphael Wilker Mendes Araújo

## What it does
- Shows one Pokémon at a time: name, Pokédex number, entry text, types, height and weight.
- Search by name or number (e.g. "pikachu" or "#25"); filter navigation by generation (G1–G9 or ALL).
- Animated sprites (Gen V and Pokémon Showdown GIFs) with static fallback.
- Shiny and normal forms, male and female forms (when the species differs), front and back views.
- Plays the Pokémon's cry.
- Device controls: D-pad (left/right = previous/next Pokémon, up/down = flip front/back), colored buttons for gender and shiny, round button for the cry.
- Deep links use the URL hash, e.g. https://raphaelwilker.github.io/pokedex/#/pokemon/25

## Tech
- Vue 3, Pinia, Vue Router (hash history), Vite, Vitest.
- Data source: https://pokeapi.co/ (Pokémon, species and sprite data).
- Deployed to GitHub Pages with GitHub Actions.

## Notes
- Unofficial fan project. Pokémon and its characters are trademarks of Nintendo, Game Freak and The Pokémon Company.
